name: Speak Lies
source:
You downloaded a totally not suspicious program from the Internet, which turns out to be a messaging app. Delighted, and full of hope for the possibility of finally making a friend, you click connect.

Instead, you bear witness to a suicide and are forced to participate in a ritual.

[Edited from the [url=https://speaklies.silentclowns.co/]official website[/url]]
translation:
你从网上下载了一个“绝对不可疑”的程序，结果发现它是款聊天软件。你满心欢喜，想着自己终于有机会交到朋友，于是点击了连接。

然而，等待你的却是一场自杀。亲眼目睹这一切后，你还被迫参与了一场仪式。

[编译自[url=https://speaklies.silentclowns.co/]官方网站[/url]]
